messages:
Alex C: Quick design question — proposing a 'collapsible scale' pattern for charts in Console. Sketch + short rationale https://imgur.com/abc123 :point_down:
Maya P: Love the idea. What's the expected default state? collapsed or expanded?
Alex C: Default collapsed for dashboards with >3 series to reduce visual noise. Expand toggles in legend header.
Samir (frontend): Implementation note: prefer it as CSS toggle + aria-expanded on the legend container. We should avoid JS-heavy rerenders.
Joan (design): Agree. Need clear affordance. Suggest a chevron + "Show axis details" label. When collapsed, show summarized unit (e.g., "ms / rps") and highest/lowest values.
Eva (a11y): Important: when collapsed, screen readers need a label like "Scales collapsed. Press to expand to view axes units and precision." Also ensure keyboard focus goes to the expanded legend.
Alex C: Proposed microcopy: "Hide axis details" / "Show axis details". Thoughts on precision? Right now we show 3 dec places by default.
Samir (frontend): For precision, suggest dynamic precision: fewer decimals for large values. Pseudocode:
```
if (abs(val) >= 1000) fmt = 0
else if (abs(val) >= 1) fmt = 2
else fmt = 4
```
This keeps labels compact.
Maya P: That logic seems fine. But need consistency across series on same panel — don't show 2 decimals on one series and 0 on another.
Joan (design): Option: show per-axis precision but in collapsed state show a single common 'display precision' badge.
Alex C: Outlier handling: two asks — (1) clipping spikes (visual cap + tooltip showing raw), (2) separate 'outlier' overlay series toggle. Which do we prefer?
Samir (frontend): I'd do overlay toggle. Clipping is risky for debugging. Overlay keeps data intact and is cheaper to implement: compute 95th percentile threshold and draw transparent overlay for points above.
Eva (a11y): If using overlay, ensure color contrast meets AA. Also add descriptive text: "X points hidden behind overlay; click to reveal full range".
Maya P: UX concern: auto thresholds could confuse users. Need an info tooltip: "We hide extreme spikes by default for readability; click to reveal." Also add a small 'why' link to docs.
Alex C: Ok action items: 
- Samir: prototype collapsible legend with aria-expanded and dynamic precision (due Fri)
- Joan: microcopy options for toggle + tooltip (due Thu)
- Eva: accessibility checklist and example SR reads (due Thu)
- Maya: docs blurb and example images (due Mon)
viz-bot: Deploy preview created: https://deploy.redwood.ai/previews/5689 :rocket:
Samir (frontend): Quick note — need tests around keyboard nav, aria-live announcements when legend expands.
Joan (design): tiny nit: change label to "axis details" not "scale details" to avoid jargon.
Alex C: Good call. Final microcopy: "Show axis details" / "Hide axis details". I'll update the sketch and PR.
Maya P: :thumbsup:
Eva (a11y): :white_check_mark: added to calendar for review.
Alex C: thanks all.
